topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I sat at my desk, sorting through the day's grading, when I noticed a small, hand-wrapped package in the corner, almost hidden from view. The card read, "To my favorite teacher, with all my thanks," from a name that made my heart drop. It was from Alex, the very student I couldn't help enough, who I often feared had slipped through the cracks. The gift, a beautifully bound anthology of poetry, was one of the books I’d mentioned in passing, a love I thought went unnoticed. Holding it, I reflected on the times I could have reached out, should have done more. Now, with this thoughtful gift, I was left with so many unsaid words and missed opportunities.
